The '''Scillal system''' was located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Cadma Conduit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Erilnar system/Legends|Erilnar]] and [[Lekua system/Legends|Lekua systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Scillal [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]<ref name="TEA" /> that were the largest [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing facility of the Centrality. The company [[Scillal Designs]] was headquartered in the system, and although the shipyards were far smaller than the [[CEC shipyards|facilities]]<ref name="Gamer" /> located in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="TEA" /> they were adequate for most of the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] requests made by the [[Centrality Navy]]. As a result, the Scillal system became a hotspot for [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] activity.<ref name="Gamer" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Scillal system was first mentioned in the article "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]," which was authored by [[Michael Kogge]] and was published in [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]]<ref name="Gamer" /> on [[July 24]], [[2001]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010627.html|text=''Gamer'' #5. A Domain of Evil it is.}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
